frozen_source.author: A. Garrett Lisi
frozen_source.title: An Exceptionally Simple Theory of Everything
frozen_source.verbatim_source_statement: The Spin^+(3,1) Lie group of gravity, with Lie algebra so(3,1), is neither simple nor compact — it is isomorphic to SL(2,C) = SL(2,R) × SL(2,R).

mathematical_scope.left: SL(2,C) viewed as a real connected Lie group / real Lie algebra sl(2,C)_R; double-cover model of proper orthochronous Lorentz transformations
mathematical_scope.right: SL(2,R) × SL(2,R) as the direct product of two real Lie groups; underlying real Lie algebra sl(2,R) ⊕ sl(2,R)
mathematical_scope.conditional_noncounterexample: Their COMPLEXIFIED real Lie algebras can become isomorphic as sl2(C)⊕sl2(C); this does not make the original stated REAL group/direct-product equality true.
mathematical_scope.do_not_conflate: Spin(3,1), Spin(4), and Spin(2,2) real forms; source's complexified D2 root system identification does not prove equality of real forms.

independent_group_center_certificate.algebraic_principle: Any group isomorphism carries center onto center bijectively; finite center orders 2 and 4 cannot be equal.

independent_real_Lie_algebra_certificate.Chevalley_relation: [E,F]=H; [H,E]=2E; [H,F]=-2F; i²=-1 for realification; cross-factor brackets zero in direct product
independent_real_Lie_algebra_certificate.Killing_formula: K_ij=Tr(ad(e_i) ad(e_j)), exact signed integer structure constants
independent_real_Lie_algebra_certificate.invariant_argument: Killing inertia of real Lie algebra is invariant under real Lie algebra isomorphism by congruence/Sylvester law; different signatures preclude the printed real Lie algebra/group isomorphism.

source_disposition.needed_next: Freeze exact integer ad/Killing verifier plus center argument with adversarial source-version, structure-constant, and false-promotion mutations; then source-conserve this negative qualifier in L-SSC-030 with no other SI changes.

qualification_boundary.source_mathematical_proof_scope: this particular real Lie-group equality only

independent_math_oracles: 6D exact Lie algebra structure-adjoint trace Killing matrix signatures
epistemic_provenance.distinction: Observation that two real forms share an abstract D2 root diagram does not grant group isomorphism or global source mathematical correctness.
